strongest_angle: Examine the October 2026 lawsuit filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York by USA Today's parent company and 13 entities against OpenAI, seeking over $250 million in damages for unauthorized scraping of paywalled articles.

key_facts.fact: USA Today Co., Inc. and 13 associated entities filed a copyright lawsuit against OpenAI in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York on October 8, 2026.
The lawsuit filed by USA Today against OpenAI seeks damages in excess of $250 million for allegedly copying hundreds of thousands of articles from 19 publications.
The legal complaint alleges that OpenAI scraped copyrighted material and paywalled articles without authorization to train and operate its large language models.

named_entities.name: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
